name: Jamie Okafor
headline: Senior/Lead Systems Designer, Product Manager
summary:
Senior/Lead Systems Designer with a track record of scaling systems and driving monetization in F2P games.
Improved retention, ARPPU, and engagement through LiveOps, economy design, and experimentation.
Acted as feature and product owner in cross-functional teams, led delivery of high-impact features, and contributed to profitable product strategy.
Open to Senior / Lead Systems Designer and Product Manager roles.

experience.position: Senior Systems Designer, Expedition and Meta
responsibilities: Owned an expedition events roadmap and execution

projects.name: Harborlight web
achievements: Increased revenue from regional social platforms by 150% by introducing a new localized pricing strategy.
Designed and introduced a new offer type, resulting in a 5% increase in Expedition event conversion rate.
Designed and implemented scalable Expedition events and balance pipelines, creating reusable frameworks for live operations across the Harborlight web portfolio.
Maintained stable monetization KPIs for Expedition events, effectively managing trade-offs to ensure consistent performance.
Improved the Expedition event pipeline, cutting production time by one week while maintaining revenue.
Fostered skill growth within the design team by coaching colleagues through iterative design reviews, codifying reusable practices for portable features.

projects.name: Meadowbrook Valley
achievements: Expanded the farm meta from 30 to 180 days, aligning with long-term retention strategy.
Launched a new Expedition format (“Story Labyrinth”), including full design and configuration.
Improved operational efficiency by automating IAP submission across multiple app stores, demonstrating fast, smart execution without over-engineering.
Designed meta systems, balance pipelines, and LiveOps content.

projects.name: Riverbend
achievements: Added a LiveOps and monetization layers prior to the hard launch, improving key retention metrics (R1/R7).
Collaborated with analytics to evaluate feature performance, using findings to iterate on monetization layers and retention drivers.
Used A/B testing to validate new monetization layers.
Mentored new designers and structured team workflows, fostering hands-on collaboration crucial for developing portable features.

projects.name: Riverbend
achievements: Scaled the core economy system and designed new meta game systems from 3 days of content to 1–2 years of gameplay.
Conducted hypothesis-driven feature iterations.
Leveraged hands-on scripting to automate balance checks, increasing efficiency and scale through self-amplification of design processes.
Developed multiple meta systems driving long-term engagement and monetization.

projects.name: Harborlight Mobile2
achievements: Introduced the Expeditions event, significantly increasing ARPPU.
Single-handedly adapted economy and balance for mobile, tuning for LTV and enabling successful global featuring, while carefully managing potential impacts on the older audience's trust.
Built and managed a 4-person design team.
Collaborated closely with the Harborlight Web team during the mobile transition, ensuring the development of portable and reusable features across platforms.
Led game design for the successful mobile adaptation of Harborlight, a key F2P title.

projects.name: Harborlight web
achievements: Introduced new LiveOps event types supporting KPI growth.
Mentored and expanded the design team to support production scaling.
Directed content roadmap and feature planning with a strong execution bias, contributing to product strategy.

projects.name: Harborlight web
achievements: Introduced a cooperative event that became the game's top monetizing event for several years.
Established reusable documentation standards to codify best practices, enabling team expansion and ensuring consistent quality and scalability.
Proactively identified and acted on opportunities to improve the product, demonstrating fast and smart execution with refinement.
Worked on 10+ casual F2P HOPA titles for mobile publishers, contributing to a diverse game portfolio.
Applied strong systems thinking to design mechanics, balance, narrative content, and technical specs, working hands-on to build adventure games.
